(()=>{const ip0=PT8.inPost;PT8.inPost=(c,dt)=>{if(c.human&&window.KB){const a=PT8.aiInput(c,dt);c.in={th:a.th,br:a.br,st:Math.abs(a.st)>.1?Math.sign(a.st):0,hb:0}}if(ip0)ip0(c,dt)};window.KB=1;const out={};for(const tr of [14,15]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:window.CAR||'merc',alt:0}],ai:[],trackRace:true});const c=RACE.cars[0];c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};let off=0,n=0,ex=0,pe=0,vmax=0,ph=null;const B={};for(let i=0;i<60*400;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count')RACE.state='race';if((c.lapT||[]).length>=1)break;n++;if(!c.onRoad)off++;if(c.exp>0&&!pe)ex++;pe=c.exp>0;vmax=Math.max(vmax,c.sp);const h=Math.atan2(c.vx,c.vz);if(ph!=null&&c.sp>5){let d=h-ph;d=Math.atan2(Math.sin(d),Math.cos(d));const la=Math.abs(d)*60*c.sp,b=Math.floor(c.sp*3.6/40)*40,sl=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(c.yaw-h),Math.cos(c.yaw-h)));const o=B[b]||(B[b]={g:0,sl:0});o.g=Math.max(o.g,la/9.8);o.sl=Math.max(o.sl,sl*57.3)}ph=h}out[tr]={lap:(c.lapT||[]).map(x=>+x.toFixed(1)),off:+(off/n*100).toFixed(1),ex,vmax:Math.round(vmax*2.237),B:Object.entries(B).map(([k,o])=>k+'kmh:'+o.g.toFixed(1)+'g/'+Math.round(o.sl)+'deg').join(' ')};PT8.cleanupRace()}window.KB=0;return JSON.stringify(out)})()
